Fade.Name: How faded a dead token looks
Fade.Hint: 1 is fully solid, 0 is invisible. Applies to the token artwork only.

Below.Name: Draw under living tokens
Below.Hint: Living tokens are drawn on top of dead ones that share the same space.

Overlay.Name: Skull across the whole token
Overlay.Hint: Draw the dead marker over the whole token instead of as a small corner icon.

Auto.Name: Mark dead at 0 hit points
Auto.Hint: Automatically mark a creature dead when its hit points reach 0.

NpcOnly.Name: Only do this for NPCs
NpcOnly.Hint: Leave player characters alone, since they make death saves at 0 hit points.

Revive.Name: Unmark when healed
Revive.Hint: Remove the dead marker when the creature is healed above 0 hit points.
